card.title: Tell Me Why
card.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

mechanism: A offers increasingly personal admissions of jealousy to draw out why B hid the invitation.
confusable: Unlike interrogation alone, A must use their own vulnerable truth as the lure for B's motive.
comparison: Emotional rivalry supplies the bait here; the station scene uses concealed professional disappointment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
